# Ace Capital Enterprise

> Ace Capital Enterprise is an AMFI-registered mutual fund distributor (ARN-113576) and quantitative proprietary trading firm established in 2016. The firm provides systematic, goal-oriented wealth management and mutual fund distribution for individuals, families, and NRIs, alongside operating an in-house quantitative proprietary trading desk across equity, derivatives, cash, and ETFs.

## Core Pages & Services

- [Ace Capital Enterprise Homepage](https://acecapitalenterprise.com/): Overview of Ace Capital Enterprise, systematic investment approach, AMFI registration (ARN-113576), mutual fund solutions, and proprietary trading capabilities.
- [About Us](https://acecapitalenterprise.com/about): Firm history since 2016, vision, core values (Systematic, Simple, Personal), team structure, and profiles of founders Rahul Singhal and Deepika Singhal.
- [Mutual Funds & Investments](https://acecapitalenterprise.com/mutual-funds-investments): Goal-based mutual fund investing, SIP and lumpsum solutions, NRI investment services, online web investing portal (mf.acecapitalenterprise.com), DhanSetu mobile app tracking, and comprehensive investment FAQs.
- [Proprietary Trading & Auto Desk](https://acecapitalenterprise.com/prop-trading-automated): Details on Ace Capital's in-house quant trading desk, low-latency execution engine, risk guardrails, and asset coverage (equities, F&O, cash, ETFs) using firm-only capital.
- [Mutual Fund Screener](https://acecapitalenterprise.com/screener): Interactive screening tool for live NAV data, fund categories, and scheme metrics across 14 leading Asset Management Companies (AMCs).
- [Client Web Portal](https://mf.acecapitalenterprise.com): Dedicated online portal for paperless KYC onboarding, mutual fund investing, SIP setup, mandate management, and portfolio tracking.
- [Careers](https://acecapitalenterprise.com/careers): Information on institutional hiring, quantitative research roles, evaluation process (Alpha Screening, Deep Tech Dive, Trading Floor, Partner Review), and firm benefits.
- [Contact Us](https://acecapitalenterprise.com/contact): Dedicated mutual fund specialists and investor support desk. Support email (support@acecapitalenterprise.com), phone (+91-9220556760), office address (Unit-210, JMD REGENT SQUARE, MG Road, Gurugram, Haryana- 122002), and investor inquiry submission form.

## Educational Content & Market Insights

- [Ace Insights & Blogs Index](https://acecapitalenterprise.com/blogs): Practical guides on mutual funds, SIP investing, and disciplined investment strategies from Ace Capital Enterprise.
- [How to Start a SIP in India: ₹500, KYC and Your First Installment](https://acecapitalenterprise.com/blogs/how-to-start-sip): Beginner-friendly roadmap to Systematic Investment Plans with ₹500, online KYC verification (PAN, Aadhaar, AMFI), AMC direct vs. regular funds, auto-debit bank mandates, the mf.acecapitalenterprise.com web portal, and the Dhan Setu mobile app.
